name: Proyecto Prisma
summary: The digital home of my software venture, presenting services, business solutions, professional expertise, and nine interactive demos for prospective clients.
functions: Presents software services, landing-page development, commercial consulting, contact channels, and nine ready-to-test demos for different business needs.
problem: Potential clients needed a simple way to understand the available services and evaluate whether a digital solution could improve their business before committing to development.
solution: I built a responsive company website where visitors can explore services, learn about my approach, and test nine interactive demos before requesting a tailored solution.
